name: OpenCage Geocoding
summary: Forward and reverse geocoding worldwide, built on open data (OpenStreetMap and others), with annotations such as timezone, currency, calling code, geohash and road info.

api_key.description: An OpenCage API key (opencagedata.com > Dashboard), sent as the key query parameter.

notes: One path does both directions: q is an address or place for forward geocoding, or 'latitude,longitude' (latitude first, decimal point) for reverse.
Free trial: 2,500 requests per day (reset at 00:00 UTC; 402 when spent) and 1 request per second (429 when exceeded). The free trial is for testing, not production.
no_annotations=1 makes answers smaller and faster when timezone, currency and the other annotations are not needed.

endpoints.name: Geocode an address or place name
endpoints.summary: Coordinates, a formatted address, its components and a confidence score for free text.

countrycode.description: Comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes to restrict results to.

language.description: IETF language code (de, pt-BR) or native; default en.

bounds.description: Bounding box hint as minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat (longitude first).

address_only.description: 1 leaves POI names out of the formatted string.

no_record.description: 1 asks OpenCage not to log the query.

notes: Check each result's confidence: it measures how small the result's bounding box is (10 means its corners are under 0.25 km apart, 0 means no box), not how likely the match is right.

endpoints.name: Reverse geocode a coordinate
endpoints.summary: The address, place and annotations for one latitude,longitude.

q.description: latitude,longitude in decimal degrees, latitude first.

language.description: IETF language code or native; default en.

roadinfo.description: 1 matches the nearest road rather than an address and adds road details (speed unit, drive side, road type).

address_only.description: 1 leaves POI names out of the formatted string.

no_record.description: 1 asks OpenCage not to log the query.
